scale_note: Real size. The wire is your caliper reading (5.53 mm); every other dimension is measured off your tape photo (1 inch = 245 px), so it is good to roughly ±1 mm. The pegboard is a generic 1/4" board, lined up on the pin.
notes_title: What changed, and what to check
notes: v2: the board interface is now shared tooling (tools/pegboard.py) for future custom parts: the 1" grid, board specs, and a hook peg + anti-rotation pin whose sizes come from your steel hook (5.53 mm pegs, 7.3 mm room behind the board, leg rising 14 mm above the hole). The blue piece is a small fit test built only from that interface: a plate with one hook and one pin. It prints on its side with no supports in about 15 minutes. Please print it in PETG and check: (1) does it hang on your board like the steel hook (tilt in, swing down, pin drops in)? (2) is it snug or loose? (3) if you can, caliper your board's hole and thickness so I can add it as the default board.
